verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a payment platform that handles merchant and customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any training exclusion control. The Agent Skills and llms.txt items cover AI coding assistance for integrations, not data-use controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
